children: TotalEnergies SE (EURONEXT:TTE) is advancing global oil plans—launching Pearl Sweet crude from Uganda with exports via EACOP, restructuring Namibia stakes with Galp on Mopane and Venus, keeping Port Arthur refinery online amid Tropical Storm Edouard, and appointing Emmanuelle Guégan to lead Marketing & Services.
: TotalEnergies (TTE) holds 56.67% of Uganda oil fields. New blended crude named Pearl Sweet; production aimed by year-end, exports planned via East African Crude Oil Pipeline to Tanga port.
TotalEnergies Namibia Deal Expands Galp Stakes
: TotalEnergies (TTE) formed a Namibia deal: Galp keeps 40% of PEL 83 (Mopane), gains 10% of PEL 56 (Venus) and 9.4% of PEL 91; Galp funding covers 50% of Mopane initial costs.
TotalEnergies Appoints Guégan President Marketing & Services

: TotalEnergies (TTE) appoints Emmanuelle Guégan as President Marketing & Services, joining the Executive Committee effective Sept 1, 2026; Bernard Pinatel will retire and leave the role the same day.
TotalEnergies Keeps Port Arthur Refinery Operating
: TotalEnergies (TTE) kept Port Arthur, TX refinery running at planned output as Tropical Storm Edouard neared; contractors sent home while full core workforce stayed onsite to maintain operations.
